# Investing in people building businesses powered by [visual technology](https://www.ldv.co/blog/what-is-visual-tech) and artificial intelligence

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/54555f7ee4b0b7b149a2117b/9593e42b-5654-4937-ac39-085d1f76fc03/Screenshot+2026-04-24+at+10.52.48%E2%80%AFAM.png)

## A majority of the data our brains analyze is visual. Therefore, the majority of the data AI will analyze will also be visual, spanning the light and electromagnetic spectrums across all sectors.

## We thrive on collaborating with deep technical teams who leverage computer vision, machine learning and artificial intelligence to analyze visual data.
